newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran urges world action to stop Israeli plan.
newsitem.headline: Iran urges world action to stop Israeli plan.

text.p: Iranian state radio called on Thursday for international action to counter Israel's decision to build homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem, which it blasted as an effort to "Zionise" the city.
"Coordinated action by world states is required to counter the occupation (of Jerusalem) and to put an end to the occupation of Palestine," Tehran radio said in a commentary.
"Compromise with the Zionist regime (Israel) would bring this regime to continue its expansionist policy," it said.
The radio blasted Israel's decision on Wednesday to build 6,500 houses for Jews in Jabal Abu Ghneim or Har Homa, calling it a plan to "Zionise Jerusalem".
Israel says all of Jerusalem is its capital. Palestinians consider Arab East Jerusalem, which Israel seized during the 1967 Middle East war, the capital of a future Palestinian state.
Iran's Islamic government, which says Israel has no right to exist, has repeatedly called for action to defend Moslem rights in Jerusalem which is the site of Islam's third holiest shrine.
